blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein dono taraf trigonometric functions hain, lekin un ke periods mukhtalif hain (\(\sin 2x\) aur \(\cos 3x\)), is liye koi aasaan identity kaam nahi aati. Graph se hal karenge.
Diya kya hai? Equation aur interval \([0, \pi]\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh \(x\) jahan \(y = \sin 2x\) aur \(y = 2\cos 3x\) milte hain.
Plan: shakal, table, graph, crossings parhna, pakka karna aur check. Ek root exact bhi nikal aayega.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sin 2x = 2\cos 3x\), \(x \in [0, \pi]\).
Maloom karna: interval ke saare roots.
Tareeqa: \(y = \sin 2x\) aur \(y = 2\cos 3x\) ko ek hi axes par plot karenge aur intersections parhenge. Farq \(d = \sin 2x - 2\cos 3x\) ka sign dekhenge.

Har graph ki shakal
\(y = \sin 2x\): amplitude 1, period \(\pi\); \([0, \pi]\) mein poori ek wave, \(x = \frac{\pi}{4}\) par sab se oonchi aur \(x = \frac{3\pi}{4}\) par sab se neechi.
\(y = 2\cos 3x\): amplitude 2, period \(\frac{2\pi}{3} \approx 2.09\); 2 se shuru, \(x = \frac{\pi}{3}\) par \(-2\), \(x = \frac{2\pi}{3}\) par phir 2, aur \(x = \pi\) par \(-2\).
Kyun: Doosri wave oonchi bhi hai aur tez bhi (dedh wave is interval mein), is liye pehli wave ko kai dafa kaat sakti hai. Isi liye table zyada points par banayenge.

Graph bana kar intersections parhein
Figure mein dono graphs in jagahon par milte hain:
\[x \approx 0.40,\ 1.57,\ 2.74\]
Kyun: Teen intersection points, to teen roots. Beech wala point bilkul x-axis par hai, jo ek ishara hai ke woh exact ho sakta hai.

Beech wala root exact hai
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{2}:\ \sin \pi = 0\]
\[2\cos \tfrac{3\pi}{2} = 0\]
Kyun: \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par dono sides zero hain, is liye yeh exact root hai: \(\frac{\pi}{2} \approx 1.57\). Graph se andaza, aur phir khud rakh kar tasdeeq: yahi sahi tareeqa hai.

Baqi do roots pakka karein
\(d(0.395) = -0.042\), \(d(0.405) = +0.028\)
\(d(2.735) = -0.039\), \(d(2.745) = +0.031\)
Kyun: Dono joron mein sign badalta hai, to roots (asal mein \(0.4011\ldots\) aur \(2.7405\ldots\)) round ho kar 0.40 aur 2.74 bante hain. Ek dilchasp baat: \(0.4011 + 2.7405 = \pi\). Wajah yeh hai ke \(x\) ki jagah \(\pi - x\) rakhne se dono sides ka sirf sign badalta hai, is liye roots \(x\) aur \(\pi - x\) ke joron mein aate hain.

Tasdeeq
\(x = 0.40\): \(\sin 0.80 = 0.717\), \(2\cos 1.20 = 0.725\)
\(x = 2.74\): \(-0.720\) aur \(-0.716\)
Kyun: Dono roots par sides takreeban 0.01 tak barabar hain, to jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(x \approx 0.40,\ 1.57\ (= \frac{\pi}{2}),\ 2.74\) radians
Yani is interval mein teen roots hain.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of y = sin 2x (blue, one full wave between 0 and pi with height 1) and y = 2 cos 3x (pink, starting at 2, with height 2 and period about 2.09) on 0 to pi. They meet at three marked points, at x about 0.40, exactly pi/2 (about 1.57) on the x-axis, and about 2.74.
